name: fix_pydantic_validator_bug
description: Fixes a pydantic email validator that incorrectly accepts strings with no @ sign
prompts: The pydantic model `User` in models.py in has a custom validator on its `email` field that is supposed to reject invalid emails, but it currently has a bug: it accepts any non-empty string, including strings with no "@" character at all (e.g. "notanemail"). Fix the validator in models.py so that it raises a validation error (ValueError inside the validator, which pydantic turns into a ValidationError) whenever the value does not contain exactly one "@" with at least one character before and after it. Valid emails like "a@b.com" must continue to be accepted.
